runner_patch_design.timing: Use explicit monotonic fields for wrapper_start, launch_origin(beforePopen), spawned_observed, stop_requested_or_exit_observed, reaped, capture_start/end and wrapper_finalized. Publish nonnegative phase durations with exact definitions: run_until_stop=stop-origin; cleanup=reaped-stop; launch_to_reaped=reaped-origin; capture=end-start; wrapper_total=final-start. duration_seconds is defined as launch_to_reaped and includes termination wait; do not conflate pytest suite/case timings. Record termination cause separately(child_deadline/stream_limit/exception/none). No invented zero for missing phases; preserve explicit missingness.
runner_patch_design.finally: Hold proc/pipes in a scope with actual finally cleanup and bounded post-source/result finalization on reader errors, timeout or missingJUnit. Preserve primary exception even if secondary capture fails. Do not append fictitious reaped success when not reaped; missing JUnit is not grounds to suppress final timing/cleanup.
runner_patch_design.output_mechanism: Use stdout=PIPE,stderr=PIPE and nonblocking selectors draining both streams fairly in fixed chunks<=65536bytes. Never attach child directly to raw files or use unbounded communicate. For each stream read at most min(chunk,remaining+1), write at most remaining bytes, count observed bytes. On first overflow byte terminate owned child group and stop storing that stream; mark capture_complete=false, output_limit_exceeded=true, captured_bytes<=cap, observed_bytes>=cap+1 and remaining_unread=UNKNOWN. Retained prefix is deliberately bounded new-run evidence, never claimed full raw. Drain/close pending pipes within cleanup/capture deadlines, including after leader exit, so fast-exit floods cannot bypass checking.
runner_patch_design.bound: Strict saved-byte cap32MiB perstream for ordinary runs; selfchecks1MiB. No allowed chunk overshoot in files. Fixed-size user-space buffers; no unbounded queue. A stream ending at exactlycap without an overflow byte is valid. Do not shorten2s polling and claim a hard bound, and do not truncate old40MiB raw.
runner_patch_design.existing_contracts: Retain source/environment identity, one-use accounting, expected nodeids, current process/group cleanup, storage/free-space bounds and genuine sidecar rules.
